open_comment_speakers.name: Stephen Sparn
open_comment_speakers.topic: asked council to adopt the Junior Academy as approved by the Planning Board.

open_comment_speakers.name: Jerry Allen
open_comment_speakers.topic: spoke to the Vista Village issue and asked why there was no agreement preventing Mr. Miller from re-erecting a fence at Vista Village.

open_comment_speakers.name: Seth Brigham
open_comment_speakers.topic: spoke in opposition to the Junior Academy Area Plan item and urged Council Member Ageton to recuse from voting on the item.

open_comment_speakers.name: Elizabeth Allen
open_comment_speakers.topic: spoke to the Junior Academy Area Plan and asked council to support what the residents wanted.

open_comment_speakers.name: Steve Pomerance
open_comment_speakers.topic: spoke to donations received by Council Member Ageton and suggested she recuse from voting on the item. He spoke in opposition to the Junior Academy Area Plan noting that spot zoning is not appropriate.

open_comment_speakers.name: Carolyn Carlat
open_comment_speakers.topic: asked for Councils assistance dealing with neighbors who rent and smoke outside which adversely affects her health.

open_comment_speakers.name: Rick Johnson
open_comment_speakers.topic: spoke in opposition to the comment that the area plan represents spot zoning.

open_comment_speakers.name: Leanne Eckelberg
open_comment_speakers.topic: spoke to the issue of affordable housing and homelessness in Boulder.

open_comment_speakers.name: Peter Richards
open_comment_speakers.topic: provided a handout for City Council and spoke to the Broadway/Euclid Transportation Project.

open_comment_speakers.name: Ron Geary
open_comment_speakers.topic: spoke to what he perceived as the skewed land use process in Boulder that he felt seemed to always favor the developer.

open_comment_speakers.name: Tanya Petty
open_comment_speakers.topic: asked what happened to the City’s court case and eminent domain proceedings for a permanent easement at the Vista Village site.

open_comment_speakers.name: Elizabeth Petty
open_comment_speakers.topic: spoke to the Vista Village issue and asked the City to pursue a written contract so all of the hard work of residents and staff was not a waste.

open_comment_speakers.name: Joe Sabel
open_comment_speakers.topic: asked Council to consider an increase of fifty cents in taxes for entertainment and events to provide more funding for social services in Boulder. He also spoke to the increase in homeless/transient crimes in Boulder and suggested panhandling permits for Boulder residents or a change for change program similar to Denver’s to keep the streets safer.

open_comment_speakers.name: Jonathan Hondorf
open_comment_speakers.topic: spoke in support of pulling the Junior Academy Area Plan off of the consent agenda and indicated he still had concerns about traffic impacts and the size of the project.

open_comment_speakers.name: Elizabeth Hondorf
open_comment_speakers.topic: spoke in support of removing the Junior Academy item from the consent agenda for further consideration.

open_comment_speakers.name: Dianne Foote
open_comment_speakers.topic: spoke to the tree removal at Willow Ridge Townhomes and the impact this would have as they used to protect the neighborhood from traffic noise on Foothills Parkway.

open_comment_speakers.name: Tim Plass
open_comment_speakers.topic: spoke to the Junior Academy Area Plan noting that he felt there are still various concerns to be worked out including the higher FAR and whether an area plan is even appropriate for that small of a site.

open_comment_speakers.name: Lynn Segal
open_comment_speakers.topic: spoke to the Junior Academy item and noted the zoning issue should be dealt with prior to approving a plan and did not support the current level of density in the area.

open_comment_speakers.name: Doris Hass
open_comment_speakers.topic: spoke in support of keeping the branch libraries open until 9 p.m.

motions.motion_text: Council Member Cowles moved, seconded by Osborne to approve consent items 3A through 3J with item 3H pulled from consent by Deputy Mayor Gray.

Council Member Cowles moved, seconded by Wilson to adopt Ordinance No. 7694 adopting the 2010 budget; adopt Ordinance No. 7695 establishing the property tax mill levy for 2009 to be collected in 2010; adopt Ordinance No. 7696 appropriating the 2010 budget; adopt Ordinance No. 7697 changing certain fees; adopt Ordinance No. 7698, as amended, changing certain development excise taxes, the education excise tax and impact fees.
motions.vote_text: The motion carried unanimously 8:0 with Espinoza opposed to Ordinance No. 7698.

motions.motion_text: Deputy Mayor Gray moved, seconded by Morzel to amend the main motion to direct the City Manager to institute a budget reallocation to keep the Meadows and George Reynolds Branch Library as they currently are in 2009 for 2010 (option A3).
Deputy Mayor Gray moved, seconded by Cowles to amend the main motion to direct the City Manager to restore the main library hours on Sundays.

Deputy Mayor Gray moved, seconded by Morzel to amend the main motion to direct the City Manager to return with options for a phased spending plan to fund the Community Literacy Program in 2010 depending on revenue targets and spending priorities.
motions.vote_text: The motion failed 4:4; Appelbaum, Ageton, Espinoza, and Osborne opposed.
